name: Nishiwaki Basin
why_it_fits: Natural bowl with 2.4km floor diameter, 127m relief (within 50-150m target), rim slopes 7-33° over 350m contiguous stretch. Best rim viewpoint sees 57.5% of floor vs 16.8% mean from floor points.
